description: OAuth-capable provider matrix extracted from upstream pi-ai at commit 8fa7eeb. Each provider has auth.oauth != null. The harness replays each provider's OAuth login flow hermetically via a fetch-interceptor shim that redirects hardcoded endpoint URLs to pinned fixture responses.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.notes: PKCE browser flow with manual_code prompt. Stdin provides callback URL with fake auth code (no state needed — state defaults to verifier when omitted). Token exchange intercepted by fetch shim.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.notes: RFC 8628 device code flow. Stdin provides empty enterprise domain (defaults to github.com). Mock returns empty models list to skip model-enablement step. Copilot token includes proxy-ep for model API base URL.

providers.name: Kimi For Coding

env_overrides.KIMI_CODE_OAUTH_HOST: redirected via fetch shim to auth.kimi.com

providers.notes: RFC 8628 device code flow against auth.kimi.com. Env var KIMI_CODE_OAUTH_HOST exists but is not needed — fetch shim intercepts auth.kimi.com directly.

providers.name: OpenAI Codex
providers.notes: Dual-mode: browser PKCE and device code. Stdin selects 'device_code' login method (headless). Device flow polls deviceauth/token (403 pending → 200 with auth code), then exchanges at oauth/token.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: PKCE browser flow with manual_code prompt. Returns a permanent API key (not access/refresh pair). Callback path includes random UUID — stdin provides a URL with code param, parseAuthorizationInput extracts code regardless of path.

providers.name: Radius
providers.notes: Dual-mode: browser PKCE and device code. Discovery-based — gateway URL defaults to https://radius.pi.dev. Stdin selects 'device-code' login method (headless) to avoid callback completion complexity. Browser flow has no manual_code prompt; device flow is fully hermetic.

providers.name: xAI
providers.notes: RFC 8628 device code flow. No stdin input needed — flow is fully automatic after login command. First token poll returns authorization_pending, second returns credentials.

credential_gated_tier.description: All 7 OAuth flows are faithfully replayed hermetically via the fetch-interceptor shim. No provider requires a credential-gated tier for flow-mechanics verification. The credential-gated live CI tier is reserved for testing against real provider endpoints (actual OAuth servers, real token exchange, real model availability) — these require real user credentials/subscriptions and are non-hermetic by definition.
credential_gated_tier.rationale: The fetch shim intercepts all hardcoded OAuth endpoint URLs and returns pinned fixture responses. Device code flows (github-copilot, kimi-coding, xai, openai-codex device, radius device) are fully hermetic. Browser PKCE flows (anthropic, openrouter, openai-codex browser) use the manual_code stdin prompt to inject the authorization code, bypassing the callback server. Radius browser flow would require callback completion but is tested via the device-code path instead. The hermetic matrix is merge-blocking; the credential-gated tier is informational only.
